head: 9da21c7cdf7a56b988d3e8521c522076ab4a493b
scope_note: R9 extends C8 (kiosk-creation chain bit-identical) by ACTUALLY emitting Z-report closes to prove the chain extends LEGITIMATELY with correct prev_hash linkage. C8 already verified the creation path is side-effect-free on the chain. R9 verifies the EMIT path (Z-close) produces a valid HMAC chain.

stress_run.outbox_stale_note: Pre-existing accumulated outbox backlog from prior dev sessions — not produced by this run (C8 saw same baseline).

post_stress_intermediate.explanation: Identical to C8 finding — kiosk POST creates orders at payment_status=PENDING; fiscal allocation requires payment confirmation per CLAUDE.md §8. audit_logs bit-identical pre+post, orders +10. Chain integrity proven by clean verify-chain re-walk.

z_close_real_run.method: ZReportService::open(1) + close(1) executed via artisan tinker

z1.interpretation: Genesis Z-report for branch 1 — prev_hash=NULL is expected (first Z, no chain ancestor). Signature is HMAC SHA-256 of (seq, branch, aggregates, closed_at, prev_hash) per ZReportService::sign + computeSignature paths.

z2.interpretation: Z2.prev_hash === Z1.signature (BIT-IDENTICAL). This is the chain link — ZReportService.php:237 reads prev_signature from the previous Z and writes it as prev_hash of the new Z. The HMAC chain is therefore PROVEN extensible legitimately.

chain_link_proof.note: Identical 64-char hex strings. ZReportCloseTest::test_signature_chains_between_consecutive_closes (line 141-152) is the regression sentinel that enforces this property.

code_static_supporting_evidence.verifyChain_called_before_sign: ZReportService.php:201 — close() invokes verifyChain($branchId) BEFORE computing a new signature. If chain is broken, close() throws and refuses to extend.
code_static_supporting_evidence.prev_hash_source: ZReportService.php:237 — $prevHash := previous Z signature for same branch (orderByDesc id, value 'signature').
code_static_supporting_evidence.sign_uses_prev_hash: ZReportService.php:239 — sign($branchId, $prevHash, $seq, $aggregates, $closedAt). The signature input includes prev_hash, so any tamper of prev_hash invalidates downstream signatures.
code_static_supporting_evidence.verifyChain_recomputes: ZReportService.php:529-540 — verifyChain walks every Z, recomputes computeSignature(zReport, actualPrevHash), and hash_equals against stored signature. Accumulates 'signature_mismatch' / 'prev_hash_break' / 'genesis_break' errors.
code_static_supporting_evidence.regression_test: tests/Feature/Fiscal/ZReportCloseTest.php — covers signature chain, tampering detection, double-close rejection.

chain_verify_post: CHAIN OK (audit_logs + z_reports) (branch=1) — SWEEP COMPLETE — CHAIN OK on every active branch (1 total)

delta_breakdown.audit_logs_count_delta_expected: 0 — stress is kiosk-creation, no payment confirmation, no fiscal_sequence allocation, no audit_log emission. Consistent with C8 finding and CLAUDE.md §8 'Allocation à création d'order (kiosk paid) ou close (POS cash)'.
delta_breakdown.audit_logs_last_hash_changed_expected: false — same explanation. audit_logs.count=64 / last_hash=8daed68a... bit-identical before AND after the 10-order stress. Strongest possible NF525 evidence: zero side-effect from 10 concurrent kiosk POSTs.
delta_breakdown.z_reports_count_delta_expected: 2 — we explicitly opened+closed two Z-reports to PROVE the chain extension path works. Z1 is genesis (prev_hash=NULL), Z2 chains on Z1.signature.
delta_breakdown.orders_count_delta_expected: 10 — exactly the 10 stress orders persisted (kiosk creation path).

V_R9_2_audit_chain_untouched_by_stress.evidence: audit_logs.count=64 and last_hash=8daed68a65b8c8e75a7143f305967047ee1bb0b664a95afb5d9d2e0657777592 bit-identical pre+intermediate. fiscal:verify-chain returns CHAIN OK after stress.

V_R9_3_z_close_extends_chain_legitimatel.evidence: Z1 closed with signature fb2f767d.... Z2 closed with prev_hash=fb2f767d... (identical to Z1.signature) and new signature 68c2983c.... HMAC chain link proven. fiscal:verify-chain re-walks both Z reports and returns CHAIN OK.

V_R9_4_verify_chain_command_green_all_ph.evidence: 3 fiscal:verify-chain --all runs (pre-stress, post-stress-pre-z, post-z). All returned 'CHAIN OK (audit_logs + z_reports) (branch=1) — SWEEP COMPLETE'. Zero TAMPER, zero gap, zero hash mismatch.

V_R9_5_code_static_close_path_robust.evidence: ZReportService.php lines 180-275 (close), 237-239 (prev_hash source + sign), 463-544 (verifyChain). verifyChain called BEFORE every close (line 201) — refuses to extend a broken chain. ZReportCloseTest::test_signature_chains_between_consecutive_closes is the regression sentinel.

caveats: Smaller stress batch than R9 brief (10 vs 50) — per brief instruction 'smaller batch to respect disk'. C8 already validated 15-order kiosk concurrency=3 stress; R9 confirms the same property at concurrency=2 AND adds the Z-close empirical extension proof which C8 lacked.

Z-reports Z1 + Z2 created in dev DB are real fiscal records. They will appear in subsequent verify-chain sweeps and in PROJECT_BRAIN audit-chain pointers. Not a frozen-zone touch (z_reports table writes are NF525-compliant via the legitimate ZReportService close path).
outbox_stale_30s=750 is a pre-existing accumulated backlog (also seen in C8) — not a regression introduced by R9.
verdict_reasoning: R9 strictly exceeds the C8 baseline. C8 proved the kiosk-creation path is bit-identical-safe for the chain (no audit_log emission, no chain tamper). R9 confirms that AND empirically proves the Z-close emit path produces a legitimate HMAC chain extension: Z1 (genesis, prev_hash=NULL, sig=fb2f767d...) → Z2 (prev_hash=fb2f767d... === Z1.sig, sig=68c2983c...). Three independent fiscal:verify-chain --all runs return CHAIN OK at every phase. The chain HMAC linkage code (ZReportService.php:201, 237, 239, 463-544) is robust and gated by verifyChain-before-sign — a broken chain cannot be extended. NF525 audit chain stress: GREEN.
